_about: Structured PPWR knowledge pool. Every 'regulation', 'implementing' and 'interpretation' entry paraphrases a document in PPWR Knowledgebase/ (path + page in 'source'); it was checked against the extracted text. 'practice' entries are TÜV SÜD / HDL good practice and are NOT legal requirements (binding=false). Do not add entries that are not backed by a source document.

regulation: 法规条文（具有法律约束力）
implementing: 实施 / 授权法案或决定
practice: 良好实践（建议，非法定要求）

entries.title: Entry into force and date of application
entries.title_zh: 生效与适用日期
entries.text: The PPWR entered into force on 11 February 2025 and applies from 12 August 2026 (Art 67(5) from 12 February 2029). Obligations without their own later date therefore apply from 12 August 2026.

entries.title: Minimise substances of concern
entries.title_zh: 尽量减少关注物质
entries.text: Packaging shall be manufactured so that the presence and concentration of substances of concern as constituents of the packaging material or of any packaging component is minimised, including in emissions and waste-management outcomes.
entries.text_zh: 包装的制造应使包装材料或任何包装组件中关注物质的存在和浓度降至最低，包括其在排放物和废物处理产物中的存在。

entries.title: Heavy metals: Pb + Cd + Hg + Cr(VI) ≤ 100 mg/kg
entries.title_zh: 重金属：铅 + 镉 + 汞 + 六价铬 ≤ 100 mg/kg
entries.text: The sum of the concentrations of lead, cadmium, mercury and hexavalent chromium resulting from substances present in packaging or packaging components shall not exceed 100 mg/kg (without prejudice to REACH Annex XVII and food-contact rules). The limit applies to the packaging and to each packaging component.
entries.text_zh: 包装或包装组件中所含物质导致的铅、镉、汞和六价铬浓度之和不得超过 100 mg/kg（不影响 REACH 附件 XVII 及食品接触法规）。该限值适用于包装及每一个包装组件。

entries.title: PFAS in food-contact packaging
entries.title_zh: 食品接触包装中的 PFAS
entries.text: From 12 August 2026 food-contact packaging shall not be placed on the market if it contains PFAS at or above: (a) 25 ppb for any PFAS measured with targeted analysis (polymeric PFAS excluded); (b) 250 ppb for the sum of PFAS measured as sum of targeted analysis; (c) 50 ppm for PFAS including polymeric PFAS. If total fluorine exceeds 50 mg/kg, the supplier shall on request provide proof of the quantity of fluorine measured as PFAS or non-PFAS so the manufacturer can draw up the technical documentation.
entries.text_zh: 自 2026-08-12 起，食品接触包装中 PFAS 达到或超过以下限值的不得投放市场：(a) 靶向分析测得的任一 PFAS 25 ppb（不计聚合物 PFAS）；(b) 靶向分析 PFAS 总和 250 ppb；(c) 含聚合物 PFAS 在内的 PFAS 50 ppm。若总氟超过 50 mg/kg，供应商应应要求提供以 PFAS 或非 PFAS 计的氟含量证明，以便制造商编制技术文档。

entries.title: Art 5 compliance is demonstrated in the technical documentation
entries.title_zh: Art 5 符合性须在技术文档中证明
entries.text: Compliance with the heavy-metal limit (Art 5(4)) and the PFAS limits (Art 5(5)) shall be demonstrated in the technical documentation drawn up in accordance with Annex VII.
entries.text_zh: 对重金属限值（Art 5(4)）和 PFAS 限值（Art 5(5)）的符合性，须在按 Annex VII 编制的技术文档中加以证明。

entries.title: Recyclable packaging — conditions and grades
entries.title_zh: 可回收包装——条件与分级
entries.text: All packaging placed on the market shall be recyclable. Packaging is recyclable if it is designed for material recycling (applies from 1 January 2030 or 24 months after the delegated acts under Art 6(4), whichever is later) and is recycled at scale (from 1 January 2035). The manufacturer assesses recyclability against the delegated and implementing acts and expresses it as grade A, B or C (Annex II Table 3); from 1 January 2038 only grades A or B may be placed on the market.
entries.text_zh: 所有投放市场的包装均须可回收。包装满足以下条件即视为可回收：按材料回收设计（自 2030-01-01 或 Art 6(4) 授权法案生效后 24 个月起适用，以较晚者为准）且可规模化回收（自 2035-01-01 起）。制造商依据授权法案与实施法案评估可回收性，并以 A、B、C 级表示（Annex II 表 3）；2038-01-01 起仅 A 或 B 级可投放市场。

entries.title: Integrated and separate components; documentation
entries.title_zh: 集成组件与分离组件；技术文档
entries.text: Compliance with Art 6(2)-(3) is shown in the technical documentation (Annex VII). Integrated components are included in the assessment of the unit; separate components are assessed separately. All components must be compatible with established collection, sorting and recycling processes and must not hinder the recyclability of the main body.
entries.text_zh: Art 6(2)-(3) 的符合性在技术文档（Annex VII）中证明。集成组件纳入包装单元整体评估；分离组件单独评估。所有组件须与既有的收集、分选和回收工艺相容，且不得妨碍主体的可回收性。

entries.title: Exclusions from Art 6
entries.title_zh: Art 6 的排除范围
entries.text: Art 6 does not apply to e.g. immediate packaging of medicinal products, contact-sensitive packaging of medical devices and IVDs, certain infant-food packaging, packaging for transport of dangerous goods, and sales packaging made from lightweight wood, cork, textile, rubber, ceramic, porcelain or wax. The Commission FAQ notes that use of an exemption should be assessed and recorded in the technical documentation.
entries.text_zh: Art 6 不适用于如：药品直接包装、医疗器械与体外诊断器械的接触敏感包装、部分婴幼儿食品包装、危险品运输包装，以及由轻质木材、软木、纺织品、橡胶、陶瓷、瓷器或蜡制成的销售包装。委员会 FAQ 指出，援引豁免应在技术文档中评估并记录。

entries.title: Minimum recycled content in the plastic part
entries.title_zh: 塑料部分的最低再生含量
entries.text: By 1 January 2030 or 3 years after the implementing act under Art 7(8), whichever is later, the plastic part of packaging shall contain post-consumer recycled content, averaged per manufacturing plant and year: 30 % contact-sensitive PET (except single-use beverage bottles), 10 % other contact-sensitive plastics, 30 % single-use plastic beverage bottles, 35 % other plastic packaging. By 1 January 2040: 50 %, 25 %, 65 % and 65 % respectively.
entries.text_zh: 自 2030-01-01 或 Art 7(8) 实施法案生效后 3 年（以较晚者为准）起，包装中的塑料部分须含消费后再生料（按生产厂和年度平均）：接触敏感 PET 30%（一次性饮料瓶除外）、其他接触敏感塑料 10%、一次性塑料饮料瓶 30%、其他塑料包装 35%。2040-01-01 起分别为 50%、25%、65%、65%。

entries.title: Recycled content: exemptions and documentation
entries.title_zh: 再生含量：豁免与文档
entries.text: Art 7(1)-(2) do not apply, among others, to medicinal and medical-device packaging listed in Art 7(4), to food-contact plastic where recycled content would threaten health, or to any plastic part representing less than 5 % of the total weight of the packaging unit (Art 7(5)(b)). Compliance is demonstrated in the Annex VII technical information (Art 7(6)).
entries.text_zh: Art 7(1)-(2) 不适用于 Art 7(4) 所列的药品和医疗器械包装、再生料会危害健康的食品接触塑料，以及占包装单元总重量不足 5% 的任何塑料部分（Art 7(5)(b)）等。符合性在 Annex VII 技术资料中证明（Art 7(6)）。

entries.title: Calculation and verification methodology
entries.title_zh: 计算与验证方法
entries.text: By 31 December 2026 the Commission shall adopt implementing acts on the methodology for calculating and verifying recycled content and the format of the technical documentation, a delegated act on sustainability criteria for recycling technologies, and rules for recycled content from third countries. From 1 January 2029 or 24 months after that implementing act (whichever is later) the calculation and verification must follow it.
entries.text_zh: 欧盟委员会应于 2026-12-31 前通过：再生含量计算与验证方法及技术文档格式的实施法案、回收技术可持续性标准的授权法案，以及第三国再生料规则。自 2029-01-01 或该实施法案生效后 24 个月（以较晚者为准）起，计算与验证须遵循该法案。

entries.title: Biobased feedstock — Commission review
entries.title_zh: 生物基原料——委员会评估
entries.text: By 12 February 2028 the Commission shall review biobased plastic packaging and may propose sustainability requirements and targets. Art 8 does not set an obligation on manufacturers today; any label on the share of biobased plastic content must follow the implementing act under Art 12(6) (Art 12(4)).
entries.text_zh: 欧盟委员会应于 2028-02-12 前评估生物基塑料包装，并可提出可持续性要求和目标。Art 8 目前未对制造商设定义务；如标注生物基塑料含量，须符合 Art 12(6) 实施法案的规定（Art 12(4)）。

entries.title: Compostable packaging
entries.title_zh: 可堆肥包装
entries.text: By 12 February 2028, permeable tea, coffee or other beverage bags and soft single-serve units (Art 3(1)(1)(f)) and sticky labels on fruit and vegetables shall be compatible with industrial composting (and home composting where a Member State requires it). Member States may require compostability for further formats (Art 9(2)). Other packaging, incl. biodegradable plastics, must be designed for material recycling (Art 9(3)). Compliance is shown in the Annex VII technical information (Art 9(4)).
entries.text_zh: 2028-02-12 前，可渗透的茶、咖啡或其他饮料袋及软质单份装单元（Art 3(1)(1)(f)）和果蔬贴纸须适合工业堆肥（成员国要求时还须适合家庭堆肥）。成员国可对其他形式提出可堆肥要求（Art 9(2)）。其他包装（含可生物降解塑料）须按材料回收设计（Art 9(3)）。符合性在 Annex VII 技术资料中证明（Art 9(4)）。

entries.title: Packaging minimisation
entries.title_zh: 包装最小化
entries.text: By 1 January 2030 the manufacturer or importer shall ensure packaging weight and volume are reduced to the minimum necessary for functionality. Packaging not meeting the Annex IV performance criteria, or with features that only increase perceived volume (double walls, false bottoms, unnecessary layers), shall not be placed on the market, unless protected by a design right or trademark registered before 11 February 2025 or covered by a geographical indication / quality scheme.
entries.text_zh: 2030-01-01 前，制造商或进口商须确保包装重量和体积降至确保功能所需的最低限度。不符合 Annex IV 性能准则，或带有仅为增加感知体积的特征（双层壁、假底、不必要的层）的包装不得投放市场，除非受 2025-02-11 前注册的设计权或商标保护，或属于地理标志 / 质量计划产品。

entries.title: What the TD must contain for minimisation
entries.title_zh: 最小化：技术文档须包含的内容
entries.text: The technical documentation shall contain: (a) the technical specifications, standards and conditions used to assess the packaging against the Annex IV criteria; (b) for each criterion, the design requirements that prevent further reduction of weight or volume; (c) any test results, studies, modelling or simulations used to assess the minimum necessary volume or weight.
entries.text_zh: 技术文档须包含：(a) 依据 Annex IV 准则评估包装所用的技术规范、标准和条件；(b) 针对每项准则，阻止进一步减少重量或体积的设计要求；(c) 用于评估最低必要体积或重量的任何测试结果、研究、建模或模拟。

entries.title: Annex IV — eight performance criteria and assessment methodology
entries.title_zh: Annex IV——八项性能准则与评估方法
entries.text: Part A criteria: 1 product protection; 2 packaging manufacturing processes; 3 logistics; 4 packaging functionality; 5 information requirements; 6 hygiene and safety; 7 legal requirements; 8 recycled content, recyclability and re-use. Part B: the TD explains (a) the outcome incl. calculation of minimum weight and volume and batch variation, (b) per criterion the design requirement preventing further reduction and the method used — substituting one material for another is not sufficient, (c) tests, market research or studies used.
entries.text_zh: Part A 准则：1 产品保护；2 包装制造工艺；3 物流；4 包装功能性；5 信息要求；6 卫生与安全；7 法律要求；8 再生含量、可回收性与重复使用。Part B：技术文档须说明 (a) 评估结果，含最低重量和体积计算及批次差异；(b) 针对每项准则阻止进一步减量的设计要求及所用方法——仅以一种材料替代另一种材料不足以证明；(c) 所用的测试、市场调研或研究。

entries.title: Reusable packaging — nine conditions
entries.title_zh: 可重复使用包装——九项条件
entries.text: Packaging is reusable only if it meets all of: designed for multiple re-use; as many rotations as possible; meets health, safety and hygiene rules; can be emptied without damage; can be refilled while maintaining product quality and safety; can be reconditioned (Annex VI Part B); allows labels and information; refilling poses no risk to workers; and fulfils the Art 6 recyclability requirements. Compliance is demonstrated in the Annex VII technical information.
entries.text_zh: 包装须同时满足以下全部条件方可视为可重复使用：为多次重复使用而设计；尽可能多的循环次数；符合健康、安全和卫生要求；可无损清空；可再装填并保持产品质量与安全；可按 Annex VI Part B 修复；可贴附标签和信息；再装填对操作人员无风险；满足 Art 6 可回收要求。符合性在 Annex VII 技术资料中证明。

entries.title: Harmonised labelling
entries.title_zh: 统一标签
entries.text: From 12 August 2028 or 24 months after the implementing acts (whichever is later) packaging shall bear a harmonised pictogram label on material composition (not required for transport packaging other than e-commerce, or DRS packaging). A QR code or other open data carrier is optional for sorting information. Reusable packaging bears a reusable label from 12 February 2029 or 30 months after the implementing act. Packaging with substances of concern will be digitally marked (methodology by 1 January 2030).
entries.text_zh: 自 2028-08-12 或实施法案生效后 24 个月（以较晚者为准）起，包装须加贴基于图形的统一材料成分标签（除电商包装外的运输包装及押金回收包装除外）。二维码或其他开放数据载体可选用于分选信息。可重复使用包装自 2029-02-12 或实施法案生效后 30 个月起须加贴可重复使用标签。含关注物质的包装将以数字方式标记（方法于 2030-01-01 前确定）。

entries.title: Manufacturer: conformity assessment, TD, DoC and retention
entries.title_zh: 制造商：合格评定、技术文档、DoC 与保存期限
entries.text: Before placing packaging on the market, manufacturers carry out the conformity assessment (Art 38, Annex VII) and draw up the technical documentation; where compliance is demonstrated they draw up the EU declaration of conformity (Art 39). The TD and DoC are kept for 5 years (single-use) or 10 years (reusable) from placing on the market.
entries.text_zh: 投放市场前，制造商须进行合格评定（Art 38，Annex VII）并编制技术文档；证明符合后须出具欧盟符合性声明（Art 39）。技术文档和 DoC 须自投放市场之日起保存 5 年（一次性包装）或 10 年（可重复使用包装）。

entries.title: Series production and re-assessment after changes
entries.title_zh: 批量生产一致性与变更后重新评估
entries.text: Manufacturers ensure procedures are in place for series production to remain in conformity. They take into account changes in packaging design or characteristics and in the standards or specifications referred to, and re-assess conformity where it could be affected.
entries.text_zh: 制造商须确保有程序使批量生产持续符合要求，须考虑包装设计或特性的变更以及所引用标准或规范的变更，并在符合性可能受影响时重新进行评估。

entries.title: Identification and manufacturer information on the packaging
entries.title_zh: 包装上的识别与制造商信息
entries.text: Packaging bears a type, batch or serial number or other element allowing its identification (or the information accompanies the product where size/nature does not allow). Manufacturers indicate on the packaging or via a QR code / data carrier their name, registered trade name or trademark and a single postal address (and electronic contact where available). The information must be clear, legible and not obscure other mandatory labelling.
entries.text_zh: 包装须带有型号、批号、序列号或其他可识别要素（尺寸或性质不允许时，随产品文件提供）。制造商须在包装上或通过二维码/数据载体标明名称、注册商号或商标及单一邮寄地址（如有，另附电子联系方式）。信息须清晰易读，且不得遮挡其他强制标签。

entries.title: Corrective action and authority requests (10 days)
entries.title_zh: 纠正措施与主管机关要求（10 天）
entries.text: Manufacturers who believe packaging is non-compliant take corrective action and inform the market-surveillance authority. On a reasoned request they provide all information and documentation, incl. the technical documentation, in a language the authority understands, electronically, within 10 days.
entries.text_zh: 制造商认为包装不符合时须采取纠正措施并通知市场监管机构。收到有理由的要求后，须在 10 天内以该机构可理解的语言、以电子形式提供包括技术文档在内的全部信息和文件。

entries.title: Suppliers must provide information to the manufacturer
entries.title_zh: 供应商须向制造商提供信息
entries.text: Suppliers of packaging or packaging materials shall provide the manufacturer with all information and documentation necessary to demonstrate conformity, incl. the technical documentation required under Articles 5 to 11, in a language the manufacturer understands, on paper or electronically; for contact-sensitive packaging this includes the documentation required by the applicable Union acts.
entries.text_zh: 包装或包装材料供应商须以制造商可理解的语言、以纸质或电子形式向制造商提供证明符合性所需的全部信息和文件，包括 Art 5 至 Art 11 所要求的技术文档；对于接触敏感包装，还包括适用欧盟法规所要求的文件。

entries.title: Empty-space ratio
entries.title_zh: 空隙率
entries.text: By 1 January 2030 or 3 years after the implementing act on the calculation method (whichever is later), economic operators filling grouped, transport or e-commerce packaging ensure a maximum empty-space ratio of 50 %; filling materials (paper cuttings, air cushions, foam etc.) count as empty space. By 12 February 2028, economic operators filling sales packaging reduce empty space to the minimum necessary (Art 24(4)).
entries.text_zh: 自 2030-01-01 或计算方法实施法案生效后 3 年（以较晚者为准）起，灌装组合、运输或电商包装的经济运营者须确保空隙率不超过 50%；填充物（纸屑、气垫、泡沫等）计为空隙。2028-02-12 前，灌装销售包装的经济运营者须将空隙降至必要的最低限度（Art 24(4)）。

entries.title: Presumption of conformity and common specifications
entries.title_zh: 符合性推定与共同规范
entries.text: Packaging conforming to harmonised standards whose references are published in the Official Journal under the PPWR is presumed to conform with the requirements of Articles 5 to 12, 24 and 26 they cover. Where no such standards exist, the Commission may adopt common specifications by implementing act, which also give presumption of conformity.
entries.text_zh: 符合依据 PPWR 在欧盟官方公报公布引用的协调标准的包装，推定符合该标准所涵盖的 Art 5–12、24 和 26 的要求。如无此类标准，委员会可通过实施法案制定共同规范，同样产生符合性推定。

entries.title: Conformity assessment (Annex VII) and EU declaration of conformity
entries.title_zh: 合格评定（Annex VII）与欧盟符合性声明
entries.text: Conformity with Articles 5 to 12 is assessed by the internal production control procedure in Annex VII. The EU DoC states that fulfilment of Articles 5 to 12 has been demonstrated, follows the model structure in Annex VIII, is continuously updated and drawn up in a language required by the Member State. By drawing it up the manufacturer assumes responsibility for compliance.
entries.text_zh: 对 Art 5–12 的符合性按 Annex VII 内部生产控制程序评定。欧盟 DoC 声明已证明满足 Art 5–12 要求，采用 Annex VIII 的模板结构，须持续更新，并以成员国要求的语言编写。出具 DoC 即表示制造商对符合性承担责任。

entries.title: Technical documentation — minimum content (Module A)
entries.title_zh: 技术文档——最低内容（模块 A）
entries.text: The TD shall make it possible to assess conformity, include an adequate analysis and assessment of the risks of non-conformity, specify the applicable requirements and cover design, manufacture and operation. It contains wherever applicable: (a) general description and intended use; (b) conceptual design, manufacturing drawings and materials of components; (c) explanations needed to understand the drawings and the operation of the packaging; (d) list of harmonised standards / common specifications / other technical specifications applied, or the solutions adopted; (e) a qualitative description of how the Art 6, 10 and 11 assessments were carried out; (f) test reports. Point 3: manufacturing and its monitoring must ensure compliance with the TD.
entries.text_zh: 技术文档须能评估符合性，包含对不符合风险的充分分析与评估，明确适用要求，并涵盖设计、制造和使用。凡适用时至少包括：(a) 包装概述及预期用途；(b) 概念设计、制造图纸及组件材料；(c) 理解图纸及包装结构与使用所需的说明；(d) 所采用的协调标准 / 共同规范 / 其他技术规范清单，或所采取的解决方案；(e) 对 Art 6、10、11 评估如何进行的定性说明；(f) 测试报告。第 3 点：制造过程及其监控须确保符合技术文档。

entries.title: EU declaration of conformity — model structure
entries.title_zh: 欧盟符合性声明——模板结构
entries.text: 1 unique identification of the packaging; 2 name and address of the manufacturer (and authorised representative); 3 sole-responsibility statement; 4 object of the declaration allowing traceability; 5 conformity with relevant Union harmonisation legislation; 6 references to harmonised standards, common specifications or other technical specifications; 7 notified body where applicable; 8 additional information; signed for and on behalf of, place and date, name, function, signature. Annex VII point 4: one DoC per packaging type, kept with the TD.
entries.text_zh: 1 包装唯一识别；2 制造商（及授权代表）名称和地址；3 独立责任声明；4 可追溯的声明对象；5 符合相关欧盟协调立法；6 所引用的协调标准、共同规范或其他技术规范；7 如适用，公告机构；8 附加信息；代表签署人、签发地点和日期、姓名、职务、签名。Annex VII 第 4 点：每种包装类型一份 DoC，与技术文档一同保存。

entries.ref: Commission PPWR FAQ (2nd ed., Aug 2026), Ch. conformity Q9
entries.title: Old PPWD harmonised standards give no presumption of conformity under the PPWR
entries.title_zh: 原 PPWD 协调标准在 PPWR 下不再产生符合性推定
entries.text: Under the PPWR the existing harmonised standards EN 13427, 13428, 13429, 13430, 13431 (2004) and EN 13432 (2000) can be used only as guidance (Recital 58); there is no presumption of conformity based on them. Exception: Art 70(1)(b) for the PPWD minimisation essential requirement until end of 2029, for which the related standard can still give presumption. Presumption returns once new harmonised standards are listed in the Official Journal.
entries.text_zh: 在 PPWR 下，现有协调标准 EN 13427、13428、13429、13430、13431（2004 版）及 EN 13432（2000 版）仅可作为指引（序言第 58 条），不再据此推定符合。例外：Art 70(1)(b) 规定的 PPWD 最小化基本要求至 2029 年底，相关标准仍可产生推定。新的协调标准在官方公报公布后，符合性推定将恢复。

entries.title: EN 13427 — use of European Standards in packaging
entries.title_zh: EN 13427——包装领域欧洲标准的使用要求
entries.text: Packaging — Requirements for the use of European Standards in the field of packaging and packaging waste. Listed under Directive 94/62/EC; under the PPWR usable as guidance only.
entries.text_zh: 包装——包装及包装废弃物领域欧洲标准的使用要求。列于 94/62/EC 指令下；在 PPWR 下仅作指引。

entries.title: EN 13428 — prevention by source reduction
entries.title_zh: EN 13428——源头减量预防
entries.text: Packaging — Requirements specific to manufacturing and composition — Prevention by source reduction. The Commission FAQ (Q8-9) says Annex C (minimisation of dangerous substances) no longer creates presumption for Art 5 but may be used until an updated standard is available; for minimisation it can give presumption until end of 2029 (Art 70(1)(b)).
entries.text_zh: 包装——制造与成分的特定要求——源头减量预防。委员会 FAQ（Q8-9）指出：其附录 C（危险物质最小化）对 Art 5 不再产生推定，但在更新标准出台前可继续使用；对最小化要求，至 2029 年底仍可产生推定（Art 70(1)(b)）。

entries.title: EN 13429 — reuse
entries.title_zh: EN 13429——重复使用
entries.text: Packaging — Reuse. Guidance only under the PPWR; reusability is assessed against the nine conditions of Art 11(1).
entries.text_zh: 包装——重复使用。在 PPWR 下仅作指引；可重复使用性按 Art 11(1) 九项条件评估。

entries.title: EN 13430 — recoverable by material recycling
entries.title_zh: EN 13430——可材料回收的包装要求
entries.text: Packaging — Requirements for packaging recoverable by material recycling. Commonly used to document recyclability until the Art 6(4) delegated acts apply; guidance only, no presumption of conformity under the PPWR.
entries.text_zh: 包装——可通过材料回收进行回收利用的包装要求。在 Art 6(4) 授权法案适用前常用于记录可回收性；仅作指引，在 PPWR 下不产生符合性推定。

entries.title: EN 13431 — energy recovery
entries.title_zh: EN 13431——能量回收
entries.text: Packaging — Requirements for packaging recoverable in the form of energy recovery, including specification of minimum inferior calorific value. Guidance only under the PPWR.
entries.text_zh: 包装——以能量回收形式回收利用的包装要求，包括最低低热值规定。在 PPWR 下仅作指引。

entries.title: EN 13432 — composting and biodegradation
entries.title_zh: EN 13432——堆肥与生物降解
entries.text: Packaging — Requirements for packaging recoverable through composting and biodegradation — test scheme and evaluation criteria. Art 9(6) requires the Commission to request updated harmonised standards; until then EN 13432 serves as guidance.
entries.text_zh: 包装——可通过堆肥和生物降解回收的包装要求——测试方案与评价准则。Art 9(6) 要求委员会委托更新协调标准；在此之前 EN 13432 作为指引。

entries.title: Identification system for packaging materials (numbering and abbreviations)
entries.title_zh: 包装材料识别体系（编号与缩写）
entries.text: Establishes the numbering and abbreviations used to identify packaging materials (plastics, paper and fibreboard, metals, wood, textiles, glass, composites) under Directive 94/62/EC; their use is voluntary. Will be superseded in practice by the harmonised Art 12 label once its implementing act applies.
entries.text_zh: 确立 94/62/EC 指令下识别包装材料（塑料、纸与纤维板、金属、木材、纺织品、玻璃、复合材料）的编号和缩写；自愿使用。Art 12 统一标签实施法案适用后，实际上将被取代。

entries.title: Heavy-metal derogation for glass packaging
entries.title_zh: 玻璃包装的重金属豁免
entries.text: Conditions for a derogation for glass packaging from the heavy-metal concentration levels, adopted because recycled glass can be contaminated with lead-containing glass. Art 5(8) PPWR allows delegated acts that only amend the derogations established in Decisions 2001/171/EC and 2009/292/EC. (Note: the knowledge-base file name says 'plastic crates' but the document is the glass decision.)
entries.text_zh: 规定玻璃包装豁免重金属浓度限值的条件，原因是再生玻璃可能被含铅玻璃污染。PPWR Art 5(8) 规定相关授权法案只能修订 2001/171/EC 和 2009/292/EC 决定所确立的豁免。（注：知识库文件名写作“plastic crates”，但内容为玻璃包装决定。）

entries.title: Historic heavy-metal derogation for plastic crates and pallets
entries.title_zh: 塑料周转箱和托盘的历史重金属豁免
entries.text: Established conditions for a derogation for plastic crates and plastic pallets from the 94/62/EC heavy-metal levels, initially limited in time. Check the current status before relying on it; Art 5(8) PPWR refers to Decisions 2001/171/EC and 2009/292/EC. (Note: the knowledge-base file name says 'glass' but the document concerns plastic crates and pallets.)
entries.text_zh: 规定塑料周转箱和塑料托盘豁免 94/62/EC 重金属限值的条件，最初设有期限。依赖前须核实现行状态；PPWR Art 5(8) 引用的是 2001/171/EC 和 2009/292/EC 决定。（注：知识库文件名写作“glass”，但内容为塑料周转箱和托盘。）

entries.title: Recycled plastic content in single-use plastic beverage bottles (SUPD)
entries.title_zh: 一次性塑料饮料瓶的再生塑料含量（SUPD）
entries.text: Implementing Decision of 30 June 2026 under Directive (EU) 2019/904 on the calculation, verification and reporting of recycled plastic content in single-use plastic beverage bottles; introduces mass-balance accounting for recycling methods beyond Regulation (EU) 2022/1616 and repeals Implementing Decision (EU) 2023/2683. A corrigendum replaced its annexes (formulas: RC = R/W × 100 %, with body, cap/lid and label/sleeve counted).
entries.text_zh: 2026-06-30 依据 (EU) 2019/904 指令通过的实施决定，规定一次性塑料饮料瓶再生塑料含量的计算、验证和报告；对 (EU) 2022/1616 法规以外的回收方法引入质量平衡核算，并废止 (EU) 2023/2683 实施决定。勘误替换了其附件（公式：RC = R/W × 100%，瓶身、瓶盖/盖子、标签/套标均计入）。

entries.title: Exemption from 100 % reuse requirement for pallet wrappings and straps
entries.title_zh: 托盘缠绕膜和捆扎带免于 100% 重复使用要求
entries.text: Delegated decision supplementing the PPWR by exempting certain economic operators that use pallet wrappings and straps from the 100 % reuse requirement for these formats (re-use targets applying from 2030). The copy in the knowledge base is the Commission-adopted text (C(2026) 511 final, no OJ number yet): a delegated act enters into force only after publication in the Official Journal once the scrutiny period has passed. Concerns the operators' re-use obligations, not the Annex VII technical documentation of the packaging itself.
entries.text_zh: 补充 PPWR 的授权决定：豁免使用托盘缠绕膜和捆扎带的特定经济运营者对这些形式的 100% 重复使用要求（重复使用目标自 2030 年起适用）。知识库中为委员会通过的文本（C(2026) 511 final，尚无官方公报编号）：授权法案须在审查期结束并在官方公报公布后方生效。涉及运营者的重复使用义务，而非包装本身的 Annex VII 技术文档。

entries.ref: Call for evidence — three acts under Art 7 PPWR (indicative Q4 2026)
entries.title: Upcoming: recycled-content calculation & verification, recycling-technology criteria, import conditions
entries.title_zh: 即将出台：再生含量计算与验证、回收技术标准、进口条件
entries.text: Commission call for evidence on two implementing acts and one delegated act under Art 7: (1) calculation and verification of plastic recycled content, (2) sustainability criteria for plastic recycling technologies, (3) conditions for importing plastic recyclates or articles with recycled content from third countries. Draft stage — content and timing may change.
entries.text_zh: 委员会就 Art 7 下两项实施法案和一项授权法案征求证据：(1) 塑料再生含量计算与验证；(2) 塑料回收技术可持续性标准；(3) 从第三国进口塑料再生料或含再生料制品的条件。处于草案阶段，内容和时间可能变化。

entries.ref: PPWR substances-of-concern list — stakeholder consultation (15 Jul 2026)
entries.title: Draft list of substances of concern in packaging (consultation)
entries.title_zh: 包装关注物质清单草案（征询意见）
entries.text: Consultation spreadsheet identifying candidate substances of concern in packaging (CAS/EC numbers, CLH/SVHC/POP status, negative impact on recycling, packaging material and technical function), prepared for the Art 5(2) report due by 31 December 2026. It creates no new limit value; it signals which substances future restrictions may target.
entries.text_zh: 征询意见表，列出包装中候选关注物质（CAS/EC 号、CLH/SVHC/POP 状态、对回收的负面影响、包装材料及技术功能），服务于 2026-12-31 前完成的 Art 5(2) 报告。它不设新的限值，但提示未来可能限制的物质。

entries.ref: Commission PPWR FAQ (2nd ed., Aug 2026), Q10 importers/manufacturers
entries.title: Drawings and component materials must be in the manufacturer's TD
entries.title_zh: 图纸和组件材料须纳入制造商的技术文档
entries.text: Annex VII requires the TD to include at least the conceptual design, manufacturing drawings and materials of components. The manufacturer bears legal responsibility and must comply with this provision; it should protect commercially sensitive information under EU and national law (it is not enough to rely on the supplier retaining the information).
entries.text_zh: Annex VII 要求技术文档至少包含概念设计、制造图纸及组件材料。制造商承担法律责任，须遵守该规定；同时应依欧盟和国家法律保护商业敏感信息（不能仅依赖供应商保存这些信息）。

entries.ref: Commission PPWR FAQ (2nd ed., Aug 2026), Q8-Q9 substances
entries.title: Demonstrating Art 5(1) minimisation of substances of concern
entries.title_zh: 证明 Art 5(1) 关注物质最小化
entries.text: The Commission indicates that Art 5(1) can be assessed in line with Annex C of EN 13428:2004 (steps to determine and demonstrate minimisation), which may be used until an updated harmonised standard is available, although it no longer creates presumption of conformity.
entries.text_zh: 委员会指出，Art 5(1) 可参照 EN 13428:2004 附录 C（确定和证明最小化的步骤）进行评估；在更新的协调标准出台前可继续使用，但不再产生符合性推定。

entries.ref: Commission PPWR FAQ (2nd ed., Aug 2026), Q10-Q11 conformity
entries.title: One DoC per packaging type; transport packaging too
entries.title_zh: 每种包装类型一份 DoC；运输包装同样需要
entries.text: A DoC is drawn up for each packaging type, at the level where packaging has the same characteristics regarding the applicable requirements and packaged products; different sizes of the same bottle with the same product may share one DoC if size does not affect compliance. Transport packaging (pallets, collars, wrappings, straps) is not exempt and needs separate assessments and DoCs.
entries.text_zh: 每种包装类型出具一份 DoC，以适用要求和所装产品特性相同为界；装同一产品、尺寸不同的同款瓶子，如尺寸不影响符合性，可共用一份 DoC。运输包装（托盘、围板、缠绕膜、捆扎带）不豁免，须分别评估并出具 DoC。

entries.ref: Commission PPWR FAQ (2nd ed., Aug 2026), Q6, Q12 conformity
entries.title: Recyclability assessment and exemptions belong in the TD
entries.title_zh: 可回收性评估及豁免须纳入技术文档
entries.text: The manufacturer carries out the recyclability performance-grade assessment and includes the result in the technical documentation before the packaging is placed on the market; use of the Art 6 and Art 7 exemptions should also be assessed and included in the TD. Market-surveillance authorities check according to national plans.
entries.text_zh: 制造商须进行可回收性等级评估，并在投放市场前将结果纳入技术文档；援引 Art 6 和 Art 7 的豁免也应评估并纳入技术文档。市场监管机构按国家计划进行检查。

entries.ref: Commission PPWR FAQ (2nd ed., Aug 2026), Q7 conformity
entries.title: Art 15(5): free choice of type, batch or serial number
entries.title_zh: Art 15(5)：型号、批号或序列号可自由选择
entries.text: 'Type, batch or serial number or other element' means any one element allowing identification of the packaging; manufacturers can choose freely among these.
entries.text_zh: “型号、批号或序列号或其他要素”指能识别该包装的任一要素；制造商可自由选择。

entries.ref: C(2026) 2151 — draft Commission Notice: Guidance document for Regulation (EU) 2025/40
entries.title: Commission guidance document on selected PPWR provisions
entries.title_zh: 委员会关于 PPWR 部分条款的指南文件
entries.text: Approved 30 March 2026, the guidance interprets selected provisions of the PPWR in response to stakeholder questions, to support uniform application across Member States. It is not legally binding; the final interpretation lies with the Court of Justice.
entries.text_zh: 2026-03-30 批准，针对利益相关方问题解释 PPWR 部分条款，以支持各成员国统一适用。不具法律约束力；最终解释权在欧盟法院。

entries.title: Industry FAQ on PPWR conformity assessment (non-binding)
entries.title_zh: 行业协会关于 PPWR 合格评定的 FAQ（无约束力）
entries.text: Industry association FAQ on the content, format and obligations of conformity assessment for the Art 5-12 sustainability requirements. Explicitly not legal advice and without prejudice to Commission interpretation; useful practical reading only.
entries.text_zh: 行业协会关于 Art 5-12 可持续性要求合格评定的内容、格式和义务的 FAQ。明确声明不构成法律意见，不影响委员会解释；仅作实务参考。

entries.title: Test reports: accredited laboratory, full component coverage, recent
entries.title_zh: 检测报告：认可实验室、覆盖全部组件、时效
entries.text: Prefer reports from ISO/IEC 17025-accredited laboratories (Art 36(2) links accredited testing to presumption for methods); cover every component incl. inks, adhesives and coatings; state method, detection limits and sample identity; keep reports recent (this service uses ≤ 24 months) and re-test after material or supplier changes.
entries.text_zh: 优先采用 ISO/IEC 17025 认可实验室的报告（Art 36(2) 将认可检测与方法推定关联）；覆盖全部组件（含油墨、胶黏剂、涂层）；注明方法、检出限及样品标识；保持报告时效（本服务采用 ≤ 24 个月），材料或供应商变更后重新检测。

entries.title: Supplier declarations that hold up
entries.title_zh: 可靠的供应商声明
entries.text: A useful supplier declaration names the material/trace code, references Regulation (EU) 2025/40 and the specific articles, states values or test-report numbers, is dated and signed by an authorised person, and includes a commitment to notify changes (supports Art 15(4) and Art 16).
entries.text_zh: 有效的供应商声明应注明材料/追溯码，引用 (EU) 2025/40 法规及具体条款，给出数值或检测报告编号，注明日期并由授权人签署，并包含变更通知承诺（支持 Art 15(4) 和 Art 16）。

entries.title: Controlled drawings and specifications
entries.title_zh: 受控图纸与规格书
entries.text: Submit released (not draft) documents with drawing number, revision and date in the title block; dimensions in mm with tolerances; materials and grammage/thickness per component; the same revision as the artwork and BOM; and a revision history so changes can be traced to re-assessment.
entries.text_zh: 提交已发布（非草稿）文件，图框中注明图号、版本和日期；尺寸以 mm 标注并含公差；每个组件注明材料及克重/厚度；与 Artwork 和 BOM 版本一致；附修订记录以便变更可追溯至重新评估。

entries.ref: TÜV SÜD / HDL good practice (manual-collection kit)
entries.title: Evidence IDs and cross-references
entries.title_zh: 证据编号与交叉引用
entries.text: Give every file an evidence ID (PU-001-C001-TST-001) and cite that ID next to each conclusion in the TD, so an authority request (10 days, Art 15(10)) can be answered with a complete, consistent dossier.
entries.text_zh: 为每个文件分配证据编号（PU-001-C001-TST-001），并在技术文档的每项结论旁引用该编号，以便在主管机关要求时（10 天，Art 15(10)）提供完整、一致的资料包。
